summary: How many korbanos chatas must a person bring if he did many melachos on Shabbos by mistake? It depends on what he forgot: that Shabbos exists, which day is Shabbos, or which melachos are forbidden.

chunks.en: They said a big rule about Shabbos:
chunks.st: stated a significant principle with regard to the halakhot of Shabbat:

chunks.en: Anyone who forgets the whole idea of Shabbos and did
chunks.st: One who forgets the essence of Shabbat,
chunks.stMore: i.e., one who is entirely ignorant of the mitzva of Shabbat according to Torah law,

chunks.en: many melachos on many Shabbosos
chunks.st: and performed numerous prohibited labors on multiple Shabbatot,

words.note: Kinds of work forbidden on Shabbos.

chunks.en: must bring only one korban chatas.
chunks.st: is liable to bring only one sin-offering
chunks.stMore: for all those labors when he becomes aware that those actions were prohibited.

chunks.en: One who knows the idea of Shabbos and did
chunks.st: One who knows the essence of Shabbat
chunks.stMore: but forgets which day is Shabbat, i.e., one who lost track of the days of the week,

chunks.en: many melachos on many Shabbosos
chunks.explain: He forgot which day was Shabbos.
chunks.st: and performs numerous prohibited labors on multiple Shabbatot

chunks.en: must bring one for each and every Shabbos.
chunks.st: is liable to bring a sin-offering for each Shabbat
chunks.stMore: when he becomes aware that he performed those actions on Shabbat.

chunks.en: One who knows that it is Shabbos and did
chunks.st: One who is aware that the day is Shabbat
chunks.stMore: but temporarily forgot that certain labors were prohibited

chunks.en: many melachos on many Shabbosos
chunks.explain: He forgot that these melachos are forbidden.
chunks.st: and performed numerous prohibited labors on multiple Shabbatot

chunks.he: חַיָּב עַל כָּל אַב מְלָאכָה וּמְלָאכָה.
chunks.en: must bring one for each and every main melacha.
chunks.st: is liable to bring a sin-offering for each and every primary category of labor that he performed.

chunks.he: הָעוֹשֶׂה מְלָאכוֹת הַרְבֵּה מֵעֵין מְלָאכָה אַחַת,
chunks.en: One who does many melachos of one kind of melacha
chunks.st: One who performs numerous prohibited labors subsumed under a single category of labor

chunks.en: must bring only one korban chatas.
chunks.st: is liable to bring only one sin-offering.

summary: There are thirty-nine main melachos that are forbidden on Shabbos. This mishnah lists them all, from planting and baking to writing, building, lighting a fire and carrying.
stIntro: This fundamental mishna enumerates those who perform the

chunks.en: The main melachos are forty minus one.
chunks.st: primary categories of labor prohibited on Shabbat, which number forty-less-one.
chunks.stMore: They are grouped in accordance with their function:

chunks.en: Planting, and plowing,
chunks.st: One who sows, and one who plows,

chunks.en: and cutting grain, and gathering it into bundles,
chunks.st: and one who reaps, and one who gathers sheaves into a pile,

words.en: and the one who cuts grain

chunks.en: threshing, and winnowing,
chunks.st: and one who threshes, removing the kernel from the husk,

words.note: Separating the grain from its husk.
Tossing grain in the wind to blow away the chaff.

chunks.en: sorting, grinding,
chunks.st: and one who winnows threshed grain in the wind, and one who selects the inedible waste from the edible, and one who grinds,

chunks.en: and sifting, and kneading,
chunks.st: and one who sifts the flour in a sieve, and one who kneads dough,

chunks.en: and baking. Shearing the wool,
chunks.st: and one who bakes. Additional primary categories of prohibited labor are the following: One who shears wool,

chunks.en: whitening it, and combing it,
chunks.st: and one who whitens it, and one who combs the fleece and straightens it,

words.en: and the one who combs it

chunks.en: and dyeing it, and spinning,
chunks.st: and one who dyes it, and one who spins the wool,

words.en: and the one who dyes it

chunks.en: and setting up the threads, and making two loops,
chunks.st: and one who stretches the threads of the warp in the loom, and one who constructs two meshes,
chunks.stMore: tying the threads of the warp to the base of the loom,

words.en: and the one who sets up threads

chunks.en: and weaving two threads,
chunks.st: and one who weaves two threads,

chunks.en: and cutting apart two threads,
chunks.st: and one who severs two threads for constructive purposes,

chunks.en: tying a knot, and untying it,
chunks.st: and one who ties a knot, and one who unties a knot,

chunks.en: and sewing two stitches,
chunks.st: and one who sews two stitches with a needle,

chunks.he: הַקּוֹרֵעַ עַל מְנָת לִתְפֹּר שְׁתֵּי תְפִירוֹת.
chunks.en: tearing in order to sew two stitches.
chunks.st: as well as one who tears a fabric in order to sew two stitches.

chunks.en: Trapping a deer,
chunks.st: One who traps a deer, or any living creature,

chunks.en: slaughtering it, and skinning it,
chunks.st: and one who slaughters it, and one who flays it,

words.en: and the one who skins it

chunks.en: salting it, and tanning its hide,
chunks.explain: Tanning makes the skin into leather.
chunks.st: and one who salts its hide, a step in the tanning process, and one who tans its hide,

chunks.en: and smoothing it, and cutting it.
chunks.st: and one who smooths it, removing hairs and veins, and one who cuts it into measured parts.

words.en: and the one who smooths it
and the one who cuts it

chunks.en: Writing two letters,
chunks.st: One who writes two letters

chunks.he: וְהַמּוֹחֵק עַל מְנָת לִכְתֹּב שְׁתֵּי אוֹתִיּוֹת.
chunks.en: and erasing in order to write two letters.
chunks.st: and one who erases in order to write two letters.

chunks.en: Building, and taking apart,
chunks.st: One who builds a structure, and one who dismantles it,

words.en: and the one who takes apart

chunks.en: putting out a fire, and lighting a fire,
chunks.st: one who extinguishes a fire, and one who kindles a fire.

chunks.en: hitting with a hammer,
chunks.explain: The last hit that finishes making a vessel.
chunks.st: One who strikes a blow with a hammer
chunks.stMore: to complete the production process of a vessel (Rabbeinu Ḥananel),

chunks.en: carrying from one domain to another.
chunks.st: and one who carries out an object from domain to domain.

chunks.en: These are the main melachos,
chunks.st: All these are primary categories of labor,

chunks.en: forty minus one.
chunks.st: and they number forty-less-one.

summary: A person is chayav for carrying something out on Shabbos only if it is the kind of thing people save. If most people do not save it, only someone who himself saves it is chayav.

chunks.en: They said another rule:
chunks.st: And they stated an additional principle with regard to the halakhot of Shabbat.

chunks.en: Anything that is worth saving, and people save
chunks.st: Anything fit to store, in the sense that it is large enough to make it worthwhile to store for future use, and people typically store items

chunks.en: things like it, and he carried it out on Shabbos,
chunks.st: like it, and one carried it out into a prohibited domain on Shabbat,

chunks.en: he must bring a korban chatas for it.
chunks.st: he is liable to bring a sin-offering for that action.

chunks.en: And anything that is not worth saving, and people do not
chunks.st: And anything not fit to store and people typically do not

chunks.en: save things like it, and he carried it out on Shabbos,
chunks.st: store items like it, since it is too insignificant to warrant storage, and one carried it out on Shabbat,

chunks.en: only the one who saves it is chayav.
chunks.st: only the one who stores it is liable.
chunks.stMore: By storing the item, one indicates that the item is significant to him, even though it is not significant for the typical person. Therefore, he alone is liable for carrying it out into a prohibited domain.

summary: This mishnah gives the smallest amounts of different things, like straw or food, that make a person chayav for carrying them on Shabbos. Things with the same amount may be added together.

chunks.stMore: is liable. The measure that determines liability for

chunks.he: חוּץ מִקְּלִפֵּיהֶן וְגַרְעִינֵיהֶן וְעֻקְצֵיהֶן וְסֻבָּן וּמֻרְסָנָן.
chunks.en: Not counting their shells, pits, stems, and bran.
chunks.st: without their shells, and their seeds, and their stems, and their bran, the husk that comes off of the wheat kernel when pounded, and their coarse bran that remains in the flour.

chunks.en: Rabbi Yehudah says,
chunks.st: Rabbi Yehuda says: None of the shells are calculated,

chunks.en: except for lentil shells, which are cooked with them.
chunks.st: except for the shells of lentils, which join together with the lentils to comprise the measure for liability because they are cooked and eaten with them.
